title: M40 RTX 5060 Ti acceptance evidence (harness output)
description: Machine-readable evidence emitted by validation/m40-rtx/harness-entry.ts. Browser-side measurements only: no secrets, no local file paths. The full RTX 5060 Ti acceptance is 10/10 points ok:true, with the one explicitly-allowed nuance that point 7 may be recorded ok:null (honest partial: validated WASM recovery) while still counting as the documented fallback proof.

userAgent.description: Runtime identity of the executing browser (hardware/runtime evidence; contains no personal data).

fatal.description: Present only when the harness itself crashed before completing the checklist — a fatal record is honest unavailability of the harness, never a GPU result.

ok.description: true = check passed with evidence; false = the required behavior failed; null = honest unavailability with the exact reason in detail.

evidence.description: Verbatim measurements (providers, timings, heap deltas, adapter info, coverage/variance, device-lost events).
